shortdesc.ph: Retrieves statistics of the media resource currently being played by the player.
Retrieves statistics of the currently playing media resource.
Gets statistical information about the current media resource being played.

section.p: This method asynchronously returns player statistics via callback, including decoding status, rendering frame rate, audio and video bitrates, etc.
This method asynchronously returns player statistics via callback.

This method is used to obtain statistical information about the player, including decoding, rendering frame rate, audio and video bitrate, etc., and asynchronously returns the results through a callback function.

plentry.pd:
Callback that asynchronously notifies the result of retrieving player media resource statistics. You can get the following information from the callback parameters:
stats: Statistics data of the media resource currently being played by the player. See .
err: Status or error information. See .
Callback interface for asynchronously receiving statistics and error information. See .

An asynchronous callback used to notify the result and possible error information of obtaining the statistics. The callback includes the following parameters:
stats: The information of the media resource currently being played. See .
err: The detailed infromation about errors. See .
